resources.string: Amplify the sounds around you through your own headphones
Smooths out hiss and steady background sounds so quieter sounds stand out
Plug in wired or Bluetooth headphones before starting. Using the phone speaker will cause loud feedback squealing.

Super Ear needs microphone access to pick up sound and play it back, louder, through your headphones in real time. Audio is processed on your device only and is never recorded or sent anywhere unless you explicitly choose to save a clip.
Microphone permission is required for Super Ear to work. You can grant it in Settings.

Super Ear is a personal sound-amplification tool, not a medical hearing aid. If you have hearing loss, please consult a doctor or audiologist. Only use Super Ear to listen to your own surroundings — using it to listen in on other people\'s private conversations without their knowledge or consent may be illegal in your area.
Tap to open • Tap Stop to turn off
Audio you hear through Super Ear is processed live on your device and is discarded immediately after playback. Nothing is uploaded or stored unless you turn on the optional \"Save a clip\" feature.
